title: Pinned legacy film and angular screening chart data

units.R_T_A: dimensionless fraction; multiply by 100 for percent

calculation_method.mean: Sum trapezoidal areas / (last valid wavelength - first valid wavelength). Not Planck weighted. Strict flag from original CSV preserved.

global_limits: Historical material: Ti Rakic with quoted upper validity 12.398 um and per-wavelength measured_lossy_wall_film conductivity model; not the current Ordal stable model.
Do not call a sparse-sample trapezoid estimate a measured or validated continuous 8-13 um emissivity.
Do not equate derived unpolarized proxy rows with independent simulations.
Source metrics can say CODE_PASS/NUMERICAL_PASS while separate convergence or energy audit remains incomplete.
